title: Procedural Plugin Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-migrated 🌀️procedural plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌀️procedural) from V1 shape to the newly-amended Shape V2 tree-purity rule per TEMPLATE.md §14. Move owner-root 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs (fix [lib] path, add ../../ prefix to #[path] strings), fold 6 sibling variant files (config.rs/terminology.rs/wasm.rs for both ◻2d and 🧊️3d apps) into their own component folders (🎚️config/🗣️terminology/🌉️wasm), merge both apps' 📚️examples/ into one owner-root 📚️examples/, and handle a known AGENTS.md collision (🎮️play/AGENTS.md vs owner-root AGENTS.md — flag, do not move/merge). Pure mechanical reshape, no logic changes. Verify with cargo check/clippy/test against the 196/196 baseline.
summary:
Retrofitted the already-migrated 🌀️procedural plugin from V1 to Shape V2 tree purity per TEMPLATE.md §14. Pure mechanical reshape, no logic changes: (1) moved owner-root 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, changed Cargo.toml [lib] path from "../../📦️lib.rs" to "📦️lib.rs", and prefixed every non-"." #[path] string with "../../"; (2) folded 6 sibling variant files (config.rs/terminology.rs/wasm.rs for both ◻2d and 🧊️3d apps) into their own <folder>/🦀️component.rs (🎚️config/🗣️terminology/🌉️wasm), updating lib.rs's #[path] declarations accordingly — no crate:: import changes needed since mod identifiers were kept unchanged; (3) merged both apps' 📚️examples/ (1 .procedural2d + 8 .procedural3d, no filename collisions) into one owner-root 📚️examples/, updating the 9 include_str!() paths in the two artifacts' 🗣️dsl/🦀️component.rs files. Root Cargo.toml/project.json needed no changes (crate was already a workspace member from batch-1 migration; namedInputs glob already covers the whole tree).

VERIFICATION: cargo metadata/-p checks are blocked repo-wide by an unrelated concurrent-session issue (📕️norm's workspace member Cargo.toml doesn't exist on disk yet — confirmed via 3 retry attempts spread across the session, not caused by this retrofit). Did full manual verification instead (logged in 🧪️manual-verification.txt): every #[path] target in the new lib.rs resolves to a real file on disk (66/66 checked); all 6 moved sibling files, all 9 moved example files, and the moved lib.rs itself are byte-diffed against pre-move git HEAD content — 100% identical except for #[path]/include_str! path strings (confirmed line-by-line via git diff); tree-purity find confirms zero non-compliant .rs/.ts files remain below the owner root; grep confirms no real external dependent references the old owner-root 📦️lib.rs path or the old per-app 📚️examples paths (only a self-regenerating .nx cache hit). Test-count baseline (196/196 from procedural's original migration) could not be re-run live due to the same blocker — the byte-identical diffs are the correctness proof for this purely mechanical change.

COLLISION FLAGGED (not touched, per STOP rule): ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌀️procedural/🎮️play/AGENTS.md documents a "ProceduralPlay" bundle/play-harness technology, distinct from the owner-root AGENTS.md's "Procedural" flow-editor description. Since the owner root already has its own AGENTS.md, this is the exact collision §14 step 5 says to STOP on. Left both files exactly in place, untouched. Open question for a human: 🎮️play/ contains only this one AGENTS.md file (no other content) — either it's meant to become a real taxonomy node later, or the file is stray and should be relocated/removed by a future decision, not by this agent.

Registrar handoff: EMPTY. [lib] path is internal-to-the-crate; root Cargo.toml's member line (…/🌀️procedural/📦️packages/🦀️rust) does not change.
